errors.evidence: The y-axis interval for daily new cases is 200,000, not 50,000 as stated.
The bars are blue-green, not gray.
The bars represent daily new cases for all dates between July 1, 2022, and August 26, 2022, not just the listed dates.
The y-axis units are '人数' (number of people) for the left axis and '报道数量' (number of reports) for the right axis, not '数量报告'.
The description does not mention that the chart illustrates the relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and related media reports.
The description does not mention the right y-axis range (0–6,000) or its interval (1,000).
The description omits the blue line chart representing daily media reports related to COVID-19.
The description does not mention the synchronization and lagging trends between the two datasets (daily cases and media reports).
